translation_notes: SD = Namespace(DEFAULT_ONTOLOGY) binds an IRI unknown until runtime, so it stays a plain Python Namespace object: no @prefix can be declared for it. Each g.objects(c79, SD.xFoo) becomes m{ {c79} {SD.xFoo} ?o } -- the predicate interpolated with bare {expr} in term position rather than a prefixed name, which is the correct outcome when the namespace's IRI is not a compile-time literal, not a workaround.

context shim: examples/.../asterism/__init__.py extends this package's __path__ to the real asterism.starrydata checked out under corpus/repos/kumagallium__asterism@f0977d4d3a, so original.py's `from asterism.starrydata import ...` resolves to the genuine ingester (ingest_curves) unmodified rather than a reinvented stand-in.
original.py restores the test file's own `_load(path)` helper (verbatim) so the region is executable standalone.
driver.py reproduces the `curves_csv` pytest fixture body verbatim and shares one tmp_path/curves_csv pair between both sides so run_pair's argument comparison sees identical values.
